visualCharacteristics: Interactive tabbed content switcher. A horizontal row of tab buttons above a bordered content panel; the selected tab's panel is visible while the others are hidden. Panels can hold paragraphs, images, and lists.
contentPattern: One row per tab. Each row has two cells: a tab label cell and a panel content cell.
usage: Grouping related content (e.g. Overview / Itinerary / What to Bring) into switchable panels on detail pages.
